application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions:
The Local Planning Authority is unwilling to grant consent for the specification detailed within the application. However, the following lesser works would be acceptable:

T1 English Oak

Remove major deadwood throughout the crown.
Prune back branches growing towards adjacent buildings to provide up to 3 metres clearance from the built structure, pruning to suitable growth points in accordance with BS3998:2010.
description:
English Oak tree in back garden has a TPO (T0725). 
Crown too large for site, within 2m of buildings. Major dead wood. Large wound in scaffold limb as identified by Complete TreeCare arborists. (report attached).

Proposed works: Reduce crown by 2m to leave crown spread of 16m. Remove major dead wood.

Tree shown by number T1 on sketch plan
